purpose: Original public-API Chicago acoustic measurements for host-only gate amplitude envelope and velocity experiment; no raw captures or vendor assets included

control_order.chicago: 22 indexed public AU controls, requested/readback/display recorded per row; no factory preset loaded

regressions_existing: all other rows; keep waveform/resonance/filter-envelope mismatches separate from amp results
split.rule: All fit parameters selected only on training first instances. Replicates are determinism checks, not independent heldout. Repeat/history are heldout diagnostics only. Fresh metrics already measured, and must never be used to retune a candidate after heldout evaluation.
split.primary_rms_bins: Temporal envelope RMSE normalized at bin2 over bin indices2..8 inclusive, centers .125 through .425 seconds, across cutoff training/heldout; relative-to-velocity100 level transfer at cutoff.6 separately. Absolute level RMSE reported separately using ONE fixed training gain at cutoff.6; no per-heldout gain normalization or new cutoff calibration curve.

interpretation.gate: Chicago amp Gate; source retains independent amp envelope. A host-only gain/envelope correction does not prove waveform/filter/amp engine equivalence.
interpretation.velocity: Reference velocities are explicit MIDI events. No vendor accent threshold or factory preset identity inferred.
interpretation.accent: Source accent_repeat accent=1 has identical Chicago events/control values to repeat. It is a diagnostic negative/control, not a reference accent label.
interpretation.metrics: 50ms RMS is unweighted absolute amplitude. Harmonic peak amplitudes from 12-harmonic least-squares fit at existing apparent f0, with DC fitted separately. Pitch boundaries flagged. Do not treat raw subtraction/phase as fidelity.
